name: What should I consider when choosing between a prefabricated and a custom-tiled shower?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing between a prefabricated and a custom-tiled shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: When deciding between prefabricated and custom-tiled showers, consider budget, design flexibility, and maintenance. Prefabricated units are generally more affordable and quicker to install, offering consistent waterproofing. Custom-tiled showers provide unlimited design possibilities, material choices, and can be tailored to unique spaces, though they often cost more and require professional waterproofing. Your choice depends on your aesthetic goals, budget, and desired level of customization.
